explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 groups by YEAR, COURSE_ID, and then filters with HAVING COUNT(ID) > 4, while Q2 groups only by YEAR and then filters with HAVING COUNT(ID) > 4. This difference in grouping affects the results.
